title: ITVX / Serif detail in print
slide_intent: Inspect the shape and contrast of a signature serif letter at large scale, because letterforms shape the tone and reading emphasis of a message.
strategic_value: This approach can strengthen a recognizable voice across different programme moods.
demonstration: A spiral-bound specimen shows a very large yellow lowercase g and a partial white letter on a dark page. Small white text sits beside the binding.
